release_notes: The click log reads like Keitaro's now. The click card shows the full device breakdown — OS and browser with versions, device brand and model, the in-app browser (Facebook/Instagram/TikTok…), and the bot's name in the previously always-empty row — parsed from the stored User-Agent when the card opens, so every old click gets it without a migration. Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Opera on iPhone are no longer stored as Safari (CriOS/FxiOS/EdgiOS/OPiOS were missed), and the Click API no longer stores Unknown for every click; one detector serves the router, click.php and the API. The dashboard's Recent clicks wears Keitaro's default columns — event ID, time, campaign, OS logo, browser logo, IP, direction — with in-app logos, a bot icon, a gear opening the column picker, and drag-to-reorder plus resize (the same grip as Campaigns); the traffic log gains OS and Browser columns with logo and version text, and the CSV export gains os/browser. "Direction" now shows where the visitor really went: the actual redirect URL with the network's sub1 carrying the click id, or the non-offer stream's action (404, text, safe page); the card names the stream that took the click, shows uniqueness and the proxy flag, and the click's domain is stored (instant migration) and shown in card, log and CSV. ISP/ASN are stored for every click instead of cloak-streams only, the false "Cloaking: Route — Money" on un-judged clicks is gone, and the log's SubID column is honestly labelled Sub ID 1. Times are consistent: the card shows panel-timezone time with the zone named plus a separate UTC row, tables show UTC on hover, and the dashboard, traffic log and card all follow the one timezone selection.
